create_llm_engine: create an sglang LLM engine using sgl.Engine with server arguments
run_batch_inference: run batch text generation on a list of prompts using llm.generate with sampling params
configure_server_args: configure sglang server arguments from CLI using ServerArgs
add_cli_args_to_parser: add server CLI arguments to an argparse parser using ServerArgs.add_cli_args
build_server_args_from_cli: build a ServerArgs object from parsed CLI arguments using ServerArgs.from_cli_args
